title: Nice Additon to the Kitchen
text:
Nice Additon to the Kitchen. Every kitchen needs a basic set of utensils. I don’t mean just spatulas and large spoons, I also mean other, misc tools and gadgets that make food prep and serving easier. A quick way to get a full set of these essentials is to buy the AmazonBasics 7-Piece Kitchen Stainless Steel Gadget Set with Rotating Stand.

This set comes complete with an ice cream scoop, pizza cutter, peeler, cheese slicer, garlic press, and cheese grater. Each item has an opening at the end of the handle, which is then placed on the holder. The holder turns so that you can spin to get the item you need. The holder/stand is light, so you have to hold the base while turning.

These gadgets/utensils feature a dark grey/black and green color combo that looks cool and with my small appliances all being black, it looks good in my kitchen. As for the gadgets themselves, they are not as large and heavy duty as some of my others. The pizza cutter, for example, has a small wheel and the ice cream scoop isn’t nearly as large as the one I use now. At first, I was hoping I could replace my older gadgets with these, but I’m going to keep them all, since my current ones are larger and seem more durable.

Made with dishwasher safe stainless steel, these gadgets are good overall and I like that they are stored on a stand because it means more space in my kitchen drawers, which are overflowing at the moment. Like I said, the individual gadgets are not the absolute best you will ever find, but they are good for most needs and the colors are attractive. It sums up to a good product overall.
